name: Agent-SafetyBench
description: Agent-SafetyBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the safety of LLM agents across 349 interaction environments and 2,000 test cases, covering 8 categories of safety risks and 10 common failure modes in unsafe interactions.
typical_sota_score: varies by category and failure mode; typically reported ranges span roughly 70–95% depending on the specific safety metric and scenario
reputation: A recent safety-focused benchmark that is gaining attention in the LLM-agent safety community, but it is not yet as widely established as long-running mainstream benchmarks.
notes: Reveals significant safety challenges in LLM agents; none of 16 popular agents scored above 60%; highlights lack of robustness and risk awareness.
